children.innerHTML: Sidequest turns your team's issue tracker into a game it actually wants to play. Quests, XP, combo streaks, one boss at a time.
Every stray task, Slack promise and shower thought lands in one inbox. Nothing escapes the tractor beam.
Sort the inbox in a daily two-minute run. Snooze, squash, or send to the sprint. Combo bonus for streaks.
Ship in weekly waves. Each teammate sees their quests, their XP, and exactly one boss at a time.
Release notes write themselves from finished quests. Confetti is configurable but recommended.
Real teams, real numbers. Scores are quests closed, weighted by boss difficulty.
